custom.q: TODO_TRANSLATE: Can you make a format we design ourselves?
custom.a: TODO_TRANSLATE: Yes. Tooling is built in-house, so a new diameter, height or stacking profile is a scheduling question rather than a supply-chain one. Send a drawing or a sample and we will come back with a tooling cost and a date.

moq.q: TODO_TRANSLATE: What is the minimum order?
moq.a: TODO_TRANSLATE: It depends on the format and whether the mould already exists. Existing formats run at a far lower minimum than new tooling. Tell us the monthly volume you expect and we will quote against it.

materials.q: TODO_TRANSLATE: Which materials do you offer?
materials.a: TODO_TRANSLATE: PP, PS, PET and PVC. The right one depends on your fill temperature, barrier requirement and shelf life — we will recommend a material with the quote rather than default to one.

lidding.q: TODO_TRANSLATE: Do your cups take standard foil lids?
lidding.a: TODO_TRANSLATE: Every format is designed around a rolled sealing rim. Tell us the lidding equipment and foil standard you already run and we will match it.

leadTime.q: TODO_TRANSLATE: How fast can you deliver?
leadTime.a: TODO_TRANSLATE: Repeat formats ship from planned stock. A new mould adds tooling time, quoted as a firm date rather than an estimate before you commit.
